title: trustshot-margins-notebook-lucia-2026
content:
Scratch notes: SOC2 prep — lightweight, but need practical checklists.

Topline/intent:
- Get a minimum viable evidence set for initial external audit (Type I target).
- Focus scope on Hosted API + Private (VPC) control boundary; Dedicated capacity can be scoped later.
- Make runnable playbook for engineers (what to pull, where to snapshot, who to call).

Quick narrative of system components (for mapping controls):
- API layer (hosted): auth tokens, rate-limit, request logs (kinesis-ish).
- Serving runtime: GPU pools, runtime process management, kernel selection telemetry (internal metrics).
- Control plane: model catalog, version pins, rollout policies.
- Private deployment: customer control plane, KMS integration (customer-managed keys), audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM.
- Observability: Console dashboards, per-route traces, token-level cost/latency traces.

Preliminary control mappings (rough):
- Logical access (AC): SRE + infra access managed via Okta roles + short-lived bastion -> evidence: okta role config export, last 90d access logs, approved access request emails.
- Change management (CM): infra as code PRs + rollout notes -> evidence: GH PR link, deployment runbook, canary roll tag.
- Logging & monitoring (DM): centralized logs (GCP/Cloudwatch) with retention policy -> evidence: retention config, sample logs, alert definitions.
- Key management (CRYP): KMS integration for Private installs -> evidence: KMS policy snapshot, process doc for key rotation, ticket for recent rotation.
- Backup & restore (BR): model artifacts + config stored in GCS with versioning -> evidence: bucket lifecycle, sample restore run log.
- Incident response (IR): on-call rota, pager duty playbook, postmortems -> evidence: last 12 months PMs, IR runbook versioned.

Open questions / things to validate quickly:
- Which environments are in-scope by default? prod-hosted only, or include staging? (ask legal + auditor)
- For Private deployments: customers may run on-prem; what artifacts can we reasonably provide as evidence from our side? (control ownership clarity)
- Token-level telemetry: retention TTLs and sampling — will auditors accept aggregated summaries?
- Are there existing SOPs for key rotation on Dedicated vs Private? I think we have docs but need owner + date.

Immediate quick wins (2–3 days):
- Export Okta role definitions and last-login for core infra roles (SRE, infra-admin, release-eng).
- Pull 6 months of alert definitions and sample alerts for main production org.
- Draft short "evidence map" spreadsheet: control -> artifact -> owner -> retention -> how-to-get it. (owner: Amir)

Longer items (2–6 weeks):
- Consolidate access approval artifacts (Jira approvals, email threads) into one folder.
- Standardize evidence capture for Private installs: a single templated checklist customers/operators fill out during onboarding.
- Run tabletop for incident response focused on exfil scenario (exposed S3 creds) — capture PM and checklist.

Draft checklist for an engineer pulled into audit hunt: (one-pagers)
- Where are my production logs? (link + query)
- How to export role membership from Okta? (steps + who to ping)
- How to snapshot KMS policy / where to find key rotation ticket
- How to show deployed model version / rollout status for a route
- How to retrieve per-route latency/cost traces for last 30 days

Risk thinking (short bullets):
- Misaligned ownership for Private deploy: we can't prove customer key rotation if it's purely customer-managed. Must show contract + onboarding checklist.
- Model provenance: binary blobs stored in buckets — need hash + signing for integrity claims.
- Cross-tenant logs: ensure no accidental tenant data in central traces during debug captures.

Notes-to-self:
- Draft the evidence-map template today; keep column for "pull-command" (CLI / SQL / query) so engineers can run ad-hoc.
- Ask legal if Type I scope narrower is acceptable for now.
- Schedule 30-min sync with Priya to review KMS docs.

Fragments / raw thoughts (brainstorm):
- Could we automate an "audit snapshot" job that collects key artifacts into a dated S3 folder? (cron + RBAC enforced)
- Minimal demo for auditor: show a canary deploy + trace from a request to model inference + alert when latency spikes — good story.
- Consider short lived "audit VM" with pre-populated dashboards and sample artifacts for auditor walkthrough.

Todo (today):
- [ ] Create evidence-map spreadsheet (Amir)
- [ ] Okta export (Lucia)
- [ ] KMS owner list (Priya)
- [ ] Book 30-min sync with legal (Lucia)

End of page. Keep rough; will tidy into a single confluence page once core artifacts exist.
summary: Personal scratch notes for SOC2 prep focusing on evidence mapping, scoping, and quick engineer playbooks. Contains control mapping ideas, quick wins, risks, and immediate todos.
